items.subject: Reduce the backward lattice work with an endpoint-faithful weighted sum
items.objective: Explore replacing the triangular backward recurrence with its equivalent binomial-weighted terminal payoff sum. Derive it from the actual loop bounds: there are 63 effective updates, and the 64 terminal values use exponents 2*j-64 for j=0..63. Preserve that endpoint convention and discounting; do not add a j=64 payoff. Validate against the baseline on varied per-element inputs and every available correctness case, including numerical edge cases. Record failures rather than weakening tolerance, and report measured latency.
